title: Final Gambit
next_chapter_hook: In the instant when all the power within Chen Ji's body completed its fusion, the heavens suddenly tore open a crack of ten thousand zhang—Cang Yutian, the Ultimate Chessmaster, descended bearing the Cosmic Eye, and a pressure beyond comprehension instantly enveloped the entire Tianqing Sect.

text.content: The twin pupils of the 49th Chess Piece opened completely, as if gazing upon the final page of the eons-long chess game—its voice rang out, carrying the weight of time beyond time: 'You've finally arrived, Chen Ji. Or rather, I've waited three thousand years for you.' Chen Ji stood before the temporal rift, feeling that gaze pierce through layers of causality and settle upon him with all its weight. In this moment, he finally understood—the so-called destiny was from the beginning a game within a game.

dialogue.content: Three thousand years... Chen has done nothing to merit such a long wait from the predecessor.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice echoed through the empty void, simultaneously humble and probing. Those chess-like eyes curved slightly, appearing to smile yet not quite, as if seeing through all his calculations. In the next instant, a brilliant pillar of light pierced forth from the depths of the temporal rift, carrying an information torrent capable of scorching the foundations of mortal Dao.

'Chen Tianming!' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Within that pillar of light emerged a phantom—the fragmented soul image of his father, Chen Tianming, missing for years, projecting a final guidance from across three thousand years of time: 'Ji'er, the complete Tianji Record is not an inheritance, but a contract. Once you accept it, you will replace me as the new Chess Player of the Heavenly Dao Chess Game.'

Chen Tianming's phantom revealed a bitter smile: 'That would be fine too. The Tianji Record will choose its own master on its own. You only need to speak the three words 'I refuse' before it, and it will seek the next Chess Player. And you... will lose all ability to foresee the future, returning to a mortal.' Chen Ji fell silent. In this moment, countless images flashed through his mind—the ten years of endured humiliation as a废物 servant, every difficult choice made with the Tianji Record Fragment, and those moments when he'd changed death's course through foresight.

dialogue.content: 'You have two choices, Chen Ji.' The voice of the 49th Chess Piece suddenly became imposing: 'Accept the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record, become the new Chess Player, inherit Chen Tianming's will, and use three thousand years of strategy to defeat the Heavenly Dao Eye—or personally destroy it, causing me to dissipate completely, severing all connection between you and this chess game.'

text.content: Just then, at the edge of the temporal rift, three figures stepped in simultaneously. Leading them, Su Qingyao wore plain white Taoist robes, her sword intent sharp as frost; followed closely by Ye Qing, surrounded by demonic path mists, eerie and dangerous; the last to enter was Chen Nian, her eyes glistening with tears, yet upon seeing Chen Ji, she revealed a resolute expression. The three formed a triangle, protecting Chen Ji at the center—a silent declaration more powerful than any words.

dialogue.content: 'Whatever you choose, I will stand by your side.' This was the first time Su Qingyao expressed such resolve so directly.
'This life was given by you; using it here seems fitting.'
'Brother, Nian'er has waited for this day for a very long time. Regardless of the outcome, Nian'er must witness it herself.'

text.content: Chen Ji looked at these three beloved ones, feeling an indescribable emotion rise in his heart. He had calculated everything flawlessly throughout his life, yet had never calculated that he would receive such heavy trust and dedication. Just then, a hoarse voice rang out from the void: 'Among seven Chess Players, you are the last. And I, Mo Xiansheng, am the seventh—and the only guardian who has never become a Chess Player.'

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan was my close friend. He entrusted the Tianji Record to me, asking me to guard his successor. I waited three thousand years, and finally waited for you—Chen Ji.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's form slowly coalesced—an elderly man appearing on the verge of death, yet his eyes were deep as an abyss, as if concealing the secrets of the entire cosmos. His gaze swept across everyone present, finally settling on the 49th Chess Piece, his expression complex. 'Three supreme factions have taken shape—the Heavenly Dao faction led by Cang Yutian, the Rule faction with the Heavenly Dao Eye at its core, and the Human Dao faction centered on Chen Ji.'

choice.prompt: The three-thousand-year grand strategy is about to conclude. Chen Ji must make the final choice at destiny's crossroads:

choices.description: Become the new Chess Player, inherit Chen Tianming's will, and use three thousand years of strategy to defeat the Heavenly Dao Eye—but the price is being forever trapped within the chess game.
choices.visible_cost: Lose Freedom, Forever Trapped in the Chess Game
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Complete Tianji Record, Command the Three-Thousand-Year Strategy

text.content: 'Excellent!' Chen Ji's voice rang like metal and stone. 'Since Heaven wishes to make me a chess piece, then I shall become the one who moves the pieces!' No sooner had his words fallen than the incomplete Tianji Record within his body shuddered violently, releasing light capable of tearing apart the heavens. Countless golden characters surged forth from the void, intertwining around him like threads of destiny.

Meanwhile, the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact hanging quietly at Chen Ji's waist suddenly emitted a hum. The seemingly ordinary Turtle Shell textures upon it actually began to glow, with countless intricate Dao patterns emerging. These resonated with the light emanating from the Tianji Record. 'That is...' Mo Xiansheng's eyes flashed with shock. 'The key to the Heavenly Realm!'

choices.description: Destroy the Tianji Record, sever the Heavenly Dao Chess Game, cause the 49th Chess Piece to dissipate completely—the price is losing all foresight abilities, returning to a mortal.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly burst into laughter toward the heavens: 'Chess Player? Three-thousand-year strategy? Chen has never coveted such a troublesome thing!' He abruptly raised his hand, grabbing the Tianji Record Fragment hovering before him. 'Since this chess game has trapped my Chen family for three thousand years, I shall smash this entire chessboard!'

However, just as he was about to act, the 49th Chess Piece let out a sigh: 'Regrettable... You are ultimately not someone who can let go. If you destroy the Tianji Record, the Heavenly Fate Lock within Chen Nian will immediately lose control. At that time, the Heavenly Secrets backlash will reduce the entire cultivation world to dust.'

choices.description: Neither accept nor destroy, but negotiate with the 49th Chess Piece as a Chess Player, opening a path no predecessors have walked.
choices.risk_hint: The 49th Chess Piece May Not Compromise

text.content: A cunning gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: 'Since the predecessor waited three thousand years, surely it wasn't merely to watch me accept or refuse?' He stood with hands behind his back, a profound smile curving his lips. 'A true Chess Player never chooses from the options others provide.'

The twin pupils of the 49th Chess Piece brightened slightly, then emitted a low laugh: 'As I expected... You, like Chen Tianming, have never been willing to be a chess piece on another's board. Very well, since you possess such boldness, I shall tell you of the third path—'

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the resonance between the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact and the Tianji Record continued to intensify. Countless Dao patterns peeled from the Turtle Shell, transforming into streams of light that submerged into Chen Ji's body. Mo Xiansheng's voice turned urgent: 'Not good! The Tianji Record sensed its master's decision and is prematurely unsealing all its power! Chen Ji, you must decide immediately!'

Chen Ji felt power surge within him like a wild tide, all fragments of the Tianji Record automatically assembling. An unprecedented power was awakening within him. Yet simultaneously, countless images flashed through his mind—he saw the terrifying full form of the Heavenly Dao Eye, saw Cang Yutian's hands, cold to the extreme, and also witnessed the impending catastrophe for the cultivation world. All of this compelled him to make a decision in an instant.

Su Qingyao was the first to sense something wrong. She stepped forward, tightly gripping Chen Ji's hand: 'Chen Ji, whatever you see, don't be afraid. We're all here.' The warm touch of her palm thawed the ice-sealed heart that had been frozen by foresight. Night Qing and Chen Nian also stepped forward simultaneously, their hands stacked together—silent support more powerful than any words.

dialogue.content: Very well. Since destiny demands I move the pieces, then I shall move it until the heavens are overturned!

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes. The Tianji Record within him finally completed its final fusion. Countless golden Dao patterns burst forth from his body, weaving and intertwining into a resplendent Dao robe phantom. His eyes transformed into Sun and Moon pupils—the left eye reflecting the past three thousand years, the right eye foreseeing the next ten thousand. At the same time, the Turtle Shell Divine Artifact cracked open completely, revealing within a Jade Slip emanating primordial气息—that was the true key to the Heavenly Realm!

'Excellent!' The voice of the 49th Chess Piece carried both relief and liberation. 'The three-thousand-year grand strategy finally has a successor. From this day forward, you are the new Chess Player—Chen Ji!' The words fell, the chess piece's twin pupils closed completely, transforming into a stream of light that submerged into Chen Ji's body, merging with the Tianji Record as one.
Just then, the heavens suddenly tore open a crack of ten thousand zhang—a pressure beyond comprehension poured down from the rift
